subject: literature
passage: After three years of work, Marguerite put her unfinished novel in a drawer and told her friends that she was done with it for good. A decade later, while clearing out her desk, she reread the first chapter and found it far less embarrassing than she remembered. Within a week she had begun to ______ the project, rewriting the opening pages and sketching an outline for the chapters she had never drafted.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

explanation.why: Marguerite had given up on the novel, but after rereading it she began "rewriting the opening pages and sketching an outline." She is bringing an abandoned project back to life, which is what "revive" means.
explanation.A: Incorrect. She abandoned the novel ten years earlier; now she is doing the opposite by working on it again.
explanation.B: Correct. To revive something is to bring it back after it has been set aside, which matches Marguerite returning to the novel she had put away a decade earlier.
explanation.C: Incorrect. She has only just begun working again and is still sketching an outline for chapters "she had never drafted," so the novel is not being completed yet.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The text says nothing about publishing; it describes her starting to rewrite and plan the novel.
